dedupe_keys.name: building permits datasf san francisco department of building inspection

description: All building permit applications filed with the San Francisco Department of Building Inspection, published on DataSF. Permit numbers can repeat when a permit has several addresses, and a deduplicated version keeps the primary address only. Columns include permit type and definition, creation, filed, issued and completed dates, block and lot, address, description, current status, number of existing and proposed stories, existing and proposed use and units, occupancy, estimated and revised cost, structural notification, a voluntary soft-story retrofit flag and a fire only flag. Coverage: the city and county. Format and access: free CSV, JSON or Socrata API under the Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License, published daily; from December 2024 the dataset publishes only new and updated rows. Caveats: the API refused requests from the environment used here, so counts and dates were not checked, and the cost fields are labelled estimated and revised cost. Useful for seismic retrofit tracking, building stock change and exposure analysis; related records are not yet linked.
